correctness.rationale: The finite binary host W=(0^r1)^k, r>=2,k>=1, has a greedy prefix/last-symbol absence/bridge test for minimal absent scattered subsequences. The claimed reachable automaton states A_1...A_r,D,B and their boundary crossing transitions classify the language without double-counting; weighted path equations eliminate to F_r(z,t)=zt(t^r+2t-2t^(r+1)z+2t^(r+2)z)/(1-(t+t^r)z+(t^(r+1)-t^(r+2))z^2). Setting t=1 gives 3z/(1-2z), hence 3*2^(k-1). Independently brute-forced candidate minimal absent words for representative r=2,3,4 and small k, reproducing exact length spectra. Finite checks support but do not replace the all-parameter state proof.
